name: Rushi Manche
current_role: Co-founder, Movement Labs (no longer in Movement's listed leadership as of Nov 2026)
profile: Co-founded Movement Labs, the team behind the Move-language blockchain network Movement, with Cooper Scanlon; the project reached a ~$3B valuation in the 2024-25 crypto cycle. Movement Network is now stewarded by a Cayman foundation and its published leadership (CEO Torab Torabi, CSO Ali Sheikh) no longer includes him.
interesting_fact: Movement is built on Move, the asset-safe smart-contract language originally developed at Meta for the Diem project, and now positions itself as a settlement and yield layer for emerging-market payments.

name: Shao Tianlan
current_role: Founder & CEO, Mech-Mind Robotics (Beijing/Shanghai; HQ also in Xiong'an)
profile: Founded Mech-Mind Robotics in Beijing in 2016. It makes industrial 3D cameras (Mech-Eye) and AI vision/motion software (Mech-Vision, Mech-Viz, Mech-DLK) that let robots pick, depalletize, assemble and inspect. Backed early by Intel Capital, it raised a ~1B-yuan Series C in 2021, is sold in 50+ countries and is now pushing 'eye-brain-hand' embodied AI for humanoid robots.
interesting_fact: Mech-Mind made its public debut at Hannover Messe 2017, a year after founding, and Intel Capital backed it in 2019. Wikipedia lists it among 2026 IPOs.
notes: Chinese name 邵天兰. Mech-Mind appears to have listed in 2026 (Wikipedia category), so an IPO prospectus would have full founder bios. Couldn't verify a deep-cut fact because the web-search budget ran out.
